name: 课程生成器
description: 把 PDF/PPT/视频/文本变成一门完整课程：生成大纲、逐篇讲义、插图与习题，并一键写入你的 Obsidian 笔记库（概念自动双链）。
description_zh: 把 PDF/PPT/视频/文本变成一门完整课程：生成大纲、逐篇讲义、插图与习题，并一键写入你的 Obsidian 笔记库（概念自动双链）。
description_en: Turn PDF/PPT/video/text into a complete course: outline, per-lesson handouts, illustrations and quizzes, exported straight into your Obsidian vault with automatic concept backlinks.
examples_zh: 我有一份 12 页的 AI 幻觉资料 PDF，帮我做成 4 章 8 节的课，先给大纲我看
大纲没问题，第 3 章调一下顺序，然后生成第一节样课看看插图什么风格
样课可以，按这个风格把整门课都生成出来
生成完了，写进我的 Obsidian 库 D:\我的课程，概念之间记得加双链
examples_en: Turn this 12-page AI hallucination PDF into a 4-chapter, 8-lesson course and show me the outline first
The outline looks fine — reorder chapter 3, then generate the first lesson as a sample so I can check the illustration style
The sample works; generate the whole course in that style
Done — write it into my Obsidian vault at D:\my-courses with concept backlinks
